title: Determine the MTU to a destination
summary: Find the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size that can pass through the network to a specific host. This helps diagnose issues where large packets are being dropped.

steps.explain: Use the --mtu flag to discover the largest packet size that can reach the destination without fragmentation.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The domain name or IP address of the destination

steps.expect: Output indicating the MTU size for the path.
